items.name: Aarhus Spring 2019

organisers.name: [{Dansk Speedcubing Forening}{mailto:formand.dsf@gmail.com}] [{Jens Fredsø Kold}{mailto:jenscold@gmail.com}] [{Karina Grandjean Beck}{mailto:karinagrandjeanbeck@gmail.com}] [{Laurids Abelsen Holm}{mailto:lauridsholm@yahoo.dk}] [{Unna Thue Breum}{mailto:unbr@learnmark.dk}]

items.information: Dette vil være den første konkurrence i Aarhus området efter mere end 6 år! Vi håber på, at se mange af jer til stede. Der er mulighed for gratis overnatning i lokalet. Læs mere på [denne fane](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AarhusSpring2019#8436-accommodation) om dette. ______ This will be the first competition in the Aarhus area after more than 6 years! We hope to see a lot of you present. There is the option of free accommodation at the venue. Please read more on [this tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AarhusSpring2019#8436-accommodation) about this.

items.name: Anaadyanta Cube Open 2019

venue.address: NITTE Meenakshi College Rd, BSF Campus, Yelahanka, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560064, India

items.information: All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except New comers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to Judge (or) Scramble in which they are participating, all this will be decided by the organising team and will be informed 2 days before the event. Additional information will be provided in the tabs.
